children: Strategy announced a proposal to amend four preferred stock series to establish daily dividend record dates, subject to stockholder approval.
The Board will seek stockholder approval at a virtual special meeting on Oct. 28, 2026, record date Sep. 25, 2026.
Amendments would set each calendar day as a dividend record date, with declared dividends payable the next business day.
If approved and filed, first daily-schedule payments expected: STRC on Nov. 2, 2026 (record Nov. 1); STRF/STRK/STRD on Jan. 4, 2027.
Changes do not alter dividend rates, total regular dividend amounts, overall obligations, or other rights and protections aside from frequency.
